text:
toni: FYI hitting a weird combo: rerank + embeddings batch helper + auth-refresh retry = missing vectors and dim mismatch in sampleapp. node sampleapp using @redwood/sdk-client shows different response shape than python and occasionally loses an item after a 401.

vik: can you share the minimal repro and what you expect vs what you get?

toni: minimal repro: 9 documents, batch_size=4, use rerank flow which calls embeddings for the corpus then sends scores. force auth token rotation mid-run. observed: node pipeline returns 8 embedding vectors, python returns 9. node returned embedding vectors with dim 512, python with dim 768 for same model alias (weird). sometimes rerank response is top-level array of floats instead of `{scores: [...]}` depending on SDK version.

marie: that sounds like two separate issues: (A) batch helper + retry duplication/missing item, (B) response shape parity and model-quant mismatch. which SDK versions?

toni: node 0.11.2, python 0.9.4. sampleapp pinned to node for the retriever path but we were testing both. logs below.

nate: paste logs and request payloads please.

toni: logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-23T09:12:01Z] batching: enqueue docs 0..3 batch_id=0
[2026-03-23T09:12:01Z] batching: enqueue docs 4..7 batch_id=1
[2026-03-23T09:12:02Z] auth: token rotate triggered, refresh start
[2026-03-23T09:12:02Z] embeddings: send batch_id=0 snapshot_ids=[0,1,2,3]
[2026-03-23T09:12:03Z] embeddings: 401 -> retrying (auth refreshed)
[2026-03-23T09:12:03Z] batching: enqueue docs 8..8 batch_id=2
[2026-03-23T09:12:03Z] embeddings: send batch_id=0 (retry) snapshot_ids=[0,1,2,3]
[2026-03-23T09:12:04Z] embeddings: response length=3 vec_dim=512
[2026-03-23T09:12:04Z] final: merged embeddings total=8 expected=9
```

vik: interesting the response length is 3 not 4 for that retry. looks like server dropped one input or our client truncated. the vec_dim=512 suggests the call landed on a different model variant (quantized/low-dim) after the retry. we have routing that may choose a cheaper rep on retries.

marie: oh right, smart-routing + fallback variants could explain dim mismatch. if retry is routed to a smaller/quantized variant we need to preserve model contract or at least normalize shape. also dropping one vector means our merging logic assumes stable index mapping but the client mutated the pending queue while retrying.

toni: repro code snippet (node):
```js
const { batchingHelper } = require('@redwood/sdk-client');
const ids = docs.map((d,i) => ({ id: i, text: d }));
await batchingHelper.enqueue(ids, async (subBatch) => {
  const resp = await client.embeddings({ input: subBatch.map(x=>x.text) });
  return resp; // sometimes list, sometimes { embeddings: [...] }
});
```

nate: a few pragmatic fixes: (1) require `id` on enqueued items and use snapshot of [{id, payload}] when sending so merging uses ids not positions, (2) SDKs should normalize responses so both produce `{\"embeddings\": [...]}` with preserved ordering, (3) make routing deterministic for retries or at least include metadata about model alias in response so we can detect dim changes, (4) add a server-side validation to reject mixed-dim responses.

vik: +1. short-term we can implement (1) and (2) in the node helper and add a thin shim in python that accepts list vs dict. longer term add a contract in the model registry: all variants serving the same alias must have identical output dims.

marie: I'll own the spec change for the model catalog and add an API field `model_alias_contract: {dim: int}`. infra will produce an alert if a variant violates contract.

toni: I opened a node PR that snapshots sub-batches and normalizes response shape in the client: https://github.com/redwoodinc/redwood-sdk/pull/2512. local runs fixed the missing-vector case. adding unit tests that simulate auth 401 in-flight.

nate: please add an e2e that rotates tokens in the dedicated canary and records routing decisions. we want to catch dim flips before they hit prod. also include a regression test in sampleapp asserting final merged length==input count.

sdk-ci-bot: canary build for branch toni/emb-parity queued (build 4603).

marie: docs/action items: update onboarding guide: "embedding shapes and model alias contracts" + add troubleshooting checklist for duo symptoms: missing vector vs dim mismatch.

vik: also add a short note in SDK changelog about response normalization so users know output shape will be consistent going forward.

toni: ok I'll merge the node patch once CI passes and follow up with the sampleapp e2e. thanks team. :metal:

nate: tl;dr: cause=retry + mutable queue + routing to variant; mitigations=snapshot ids+payloads, normalize shapes in SDKs, enforce model alias dim contract, add tests and docs.
